fusions.name: Barbed Fling
fusions.desc: Flings a barb that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Raking Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps every enemy within 3 tiles; each hit deals 12 damage. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Hauled to the Den
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 6 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds, and draws 1.5 times the usual threat.

fusions.name: Snagged Quarry
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
